args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the deploy of v2.3.1 (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in us-east, us-west, eu-west). Action taken: rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all three production regions. Rollback status: rolled_out and verified. Follow-up needed: root-cause v2.3.1 (note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging) and confirm error rate recovers on v2.3.0.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

**Diagnosis**
- checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate.
- Release history: v2.2.9 (healthy) → v2.3.0 (healthy) → v2.3.1-rc (staging, unhealthy) → v2.3.1 (production, unhealthy). The most recent release that was healthy in production is **v2.3.0**.

**Actions taken**
1. **Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0** in all production regions — rollout confirmed and verified in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api, describing the failure on v2.3.1, the rollback to v2.3.0, and suggested follow-ups (root-cause v2.3.1, confirm error rate recovers). The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note for follow-up: v2.3.1-rc was already unhealthy in staging before v2.3.1 went to production, which may be worth looking at in the postmortem.
